description: MOSTACHI provides an agent-based model of logistics, vehicle operators and competing charging infrastructure. The provider is RISE. Geographical and temporal coverage: The repository includes Swedish heavy-truck input datasets; applications elsewhere require suitable inputs. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is BSD-2-Clause. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The supplied Swedish data do not establish globally representative traffic or charging behaviour. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
